let health =
    AppRequests
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false),
                P95ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0)
      by workload = AppRoleName;
catalog
| join kind=leftouter health on workload
| extend Requests = coalesce(Requests, 0), Failures = coalesce(Failures, 0), P95ms = coalesce(P95ms, 0.0)
| extend Availability = iff(Requests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * (Requests - Failures) / Requests, 2))
| extend Status = case(
    Requests == 0,           "⚪ No data",
    Availability < slo - 1,  "🔴 Breaching SLO",
    Availability < slo,      "🟠 At risk",
                             "🟢 Healthy")
| project Application = displayName, Domain = domain, Tier = criticality, Status,
          Availability, SLO = slo, Requests, Failures, P95ms,
          Owner = owner, ['Business Owner'] = businessOwner,
          Website = appUrl, Docs = docsUrl, Runbook = runbookUrl, Repo = repoUrl
| order by Domain asc, Tier asc, Application asc","size":0,"title":"Portfolio — inventory, health and links","timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000},"queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","crossComponentResources":["__WORKSPACE_ID__"],"gridSettings":{"formatters":[{"columnMatch":"^Website$","formatter":7,"formatOptions":{"linkTarget":"Url","linkLabel":"Open app","linkIsContextBlade":false}},{"columnMatch":"^Docs$","formatter":7,"formatOptions":{"linkTarget":"Url","linkLabel":"Open docs","linkIsContextBlade":false}},{"columnMatch":"^Runbook$","formatter":7,"formatOptions":{"linkTarget":"Url","linkLabel":"Open runbook","linkIsContextBlade":false}},{"columnMatch":"^Repo$","formatter":7,"formatOptions":{"linkTarget":"Url","linkLabel":"Open repo","linkIsContextBlade":false}},{"columnMatch":"^Availability$","formatter":8,"formatOptions":{"palette":"redGreen"}},{"columnMatch":"^P95ms$","formatter":4,"formatOptions":{"palette":"blue"}}],"rowLimit":50}},"name":"portfolio","conditionalVisibility":{"parameterName":"selectedTab","comparison":"isEqualTo","value":"portfolio"}},{"type":1,"content":{"json":"### Estate map

Application Map, but for the whole estate rather than one resource. Edges come from joining each dependency to the request it caused, so these are real call paths, not guesses.

Look for **Inventory Service**: it is called by both Retail and Payments. A shared service is exactly why domain has to be a *tag*, not a boundary — when it degrades, the blast radius crosses domains. Node colour is health, edge thickness is call volume. **Hover** a node for owner, tier and SLO; **click** one to load its catalog entry below."},"name":"map-header","conditionalVisibility":{"parameterName":"selectedTab","comparison":"isEqualTo","value":"map"}},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// Estate map — a single holistic dependency graph across every workload.
//
// This is the cross-estate equivalent of the per-resource Application Map. Application Map
// is scoped to one Application Insights resource (plus whatever it discovers); this query
// spans the whole workspace, so shared services appear once with fan-in from every domain
// that consumes them.
//
// SHAPE (required by the workbook "graph" visualization):
//   The result is a single MIXED result set.
//     * Node rows: Id is set, SourceId/TargetId are empty.
//     * Edge rows: SourceId/TargetId are set, Id is empty.
//   The visualization separates them by inspecting those columns.
//
// HOW EDGES ARE DERIVED
//   A dependency and the request it caused are linked by id: the caller emits a dependency
//   with Id = X, and the callee's request carries ParentId = X. Joining on that gives a true
//   service -> service edge. Falling back to the dependency Target alone would give
//   "service -> hostname", which does not resolve to a node and would fragment the map.
//
//   Some dependencies have no matching request (sampling, or the callee's telemetry landing
//   outside the time window). Those would otherwise create a DUPLICATE node for a service
//   that already exists, so for HTTP we resolve the target hostname back to a known role
//   name. Only HTTP is treated this way; data stores keep their full target so that four
//   distinct databases do not collapse into a single node.

let roles = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize make_set(AppRoleName));
let depsResolved =
    AppDependencies
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | project depId = Id, src = AppRoleName, Target, DependencyType, DurationMs, Success
    | join kind=leftouter (
        AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | project depId = ParentId, dstRole = AppRoleName
      ) on depId
    // For HTTP only, take the first label of the hostname and see if it is a known service.
    | extend httpRole = iff(DependencyType == "HTTP",
        tostring(split(tostring(split(tostring(split(Target, "/")[0]), ":")[0]), ".")[0]), "")
    | extend isSvc = isnotempty(dstRole) or httpRole in (roles)
    // SQL/Cosmos targets look like "host:port | DbName" — the database name is the useful label.
    | extend dbName = tostring(split(Target, "| ")[1])
    | extend tgt = case(
        isnotempty(dstRole), dstRole,
        httpRole in (roles), httpRole,
        isnotempty(dbName),  dbName,
        tostring(split(tostring(split(Target, "/")[0]), ":")[0]))
    | extend tgtKind = case(
        isSvc, "service",
        DependencyType in ("SQL", "mysql", "postgresql"), "database",
        DependencyType in ("cosmosdb", "redis", "Azure blob", "Azure table"), "datastore",
        DependencyType in ("servicebus", "Queue Message", "eventhub"), "queue",
        "external");
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- nodes
let svcNodes =
    AppRequests
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | summarize Calls = count(), Fails = countif(Success == false),
                P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0)
      by Id = AppRoleName
    | extend Kind = "service";
let infraNodes =
    depsResolved
    | where not(isSvc)
    | summarize Calls = count(), Fails = countif(Success == false),
                P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0)
      by Id = tgt, Kind = tgtKind;
let nodes =
    union svcNodes, infraNodes
    | join kind=leftouter (AppCatalog | project workload, displayName, domain, criticality, owner, appUrl, slo)
        on $left.Id == $right.workload
    | extend FailPct = iff(Calls == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Fails / Calls, 2))
    | extend Domain = coalesce(domain, "shared infrastructure"),
             Owner  = coalesce(owner, "n/a"),
             Tier   = coalesce(criticality, "n/a")
    | extend Name = coalesce(displayName, Id)
    | extend Status = case(
        Kind != "service",  "Infra",
        FailPct >= 5.0,     "Error",
        FailPct >= 1.0,     "Warning",
                            "Healthy")
    // The graph visualization allows only ONE tooltip string per content slot, so compose
    // the whole hover card here and reference this column from tooltipFormat.
    | extend Hover = strcat(
        Name, "  [", Kind, "]",
        "\ndomain: ", Domain,
        "\nowner: ", Owner, "   tier: ", Tier,
        "\ncalls: ", Calls, "   failures: ", Fails, " (", FailPct, "%)",
        "\nP95: ", P95, " ms",
        iff(isempty(appUrl), "", strcat("\n", appUrl)))
    | project Id, Name, Kind, Domain, Owner, Tier, Calls, Fails, FailPct, P95, Status, Hover;
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- edges
let links =
    depsResolved
    | summarize Calls = count(), Fails = countif(Success == false) by SourceId = src, TargetId = tgt, DependencyType
    | extend EdgeLabel = iff(Fails > 0, strcat(DependencyType, "  ", Calls, "  (", Fails, " failed)"),
                                        strcat(DependencyType, "  ", Calls))
    | project SourceId, TargetId, Calls, EdgeLabel;
nodes
| union links
